name: @patchworkos/friday-recap
description: Friday 4pm weekly recap: closed Linear issues, calendar load, and active Slack threads — composed into a wins/losses summary posted to Slack and optionally appended to a Notion weekly log.
author: patchworkos

SLACK_CHANNEL.description: Slack channel or DM to post the weekly recap to

LINEAR_TEAM_ID.description: Linear team ID to scope assigned-issue queries

WEEK_START_ISO.description: ISO timestamp for the start of the recap week (typically Monday 00:00 local)

NOTION_WEEKLY_LOG_DB.description: Notion database ID for the weekly log. Omit to skip the Notion append step.
